sources.title: DiffSign: AI-Assisted Generation of Customizable
sources.snippet: These results show that our approach of visually conditioning the signer generation on just a single signer image using a pre-trained model with a visual adapter, results in lower jitter compared to the text conditioned models and outperforms even the fine-tuned model.
